title: Agentic · Bind combined validator into live claim-ready consumer
mission: Bind the existing validateClaimReadyCompiledDispatch adapter into the actual allocator/compiled-dispatch consumer that decides claim-ready publication. Reuse the current owner and preserve authority. The real consumer must fail closed on structural or mechanical validation failure. Add a bounded production-path regression; do not build a new scheduler, queue, planner or authority surface.
definition_of_done: The actual claim-ready consumer imports and executes validateClaimReadyCompiledDispatch before publishing compatible work.
Structural and mechanical failures each fail closed in the real consumer path and preserve their error classes.
A bounded regression exercises the production consumer path, not only the adapter in isolation.
Existing compatible compiled-dispatch regressions remain PASS.
No scheduling, execution, promotion or human-approval authority is expanded.
allowed_scope: the existing allocator/compiled-dispatch claim-ready consumer identified from current main
bounded regressions for that existing consumer
forbidden_scope: claiming live enforcement without executing the actual consumer regression

semantic_identity.problem: combined structural plus mechanical validator exists and is tested in isolation but the actual allocator consumer does not import or execute it before claim-ready publication
acceptance: actual claim-ready consumer imports and executes validateclaimreadycompileddispatch before publishing compatible work
bounded regression proves the production consumer path rather than only the adapter
existing compatible compiled-dispatch regressions remain pass
invalid structural or mechanical contracts fail closed in the real consumer path

truth_boundary: This job wires an existing validator into an existing consumer; it grants no claim, scheduling, promotion or human-approval authority.
